real_defects.issue: Student loan counted all unearned income; GOV.UK (as fetched by the 2026-11-17 census audit) counts it only when it is over 2,000. 30,000 pay + 1,500 interest on Plan 2 showed 272.70 instead of 137.70.
Plan 5 was charged for 2025/26 (40,000 pay -> 1,350) although Plan 5 repayments start in April 2026.

The property allowance was chosen whenever it beat expenses, forfeiting a larger mortgage-interest credit: 30,000 pay, 10,000 rent, 500 expenses, 6,000 interest -> 5,286 tax instead of 4,186, with a 1,100 cliff at 501 of expenses. Now both routes are priced and the lower bill wins.

Money formatters with minimumFractionDigits 0 / maximumFractionDigits 2 printed one pence digit: 'GBP 2,191.8', 'Balance £5,955.3', 'GBP 0.5'. Padded in every copy; check_money_pence.py guards the class.
